item.title: Over 200 Parrots Found Dead Near Narmada in MP, Food Poisoning Suspected
item.description: GUWAHATI: More than 200 parrots were found dead along the banks of the Narmada River near the Badwah area of Khargone district in Madhya Pradesh, in what officials have called a serious environmental incident. Initial investigations suggest that the birds died due to severe food poisoning. item.title: Guwahati Sees First Use of POEM for Swallowing Disorder
item.description: Apollo Hospitals Guwahati has successfully performed Per Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM), an advanced endoscopic procedure used in the treatment of Achalasia Cardia, a swallowing disorder. This is the first reported instance of the procedure being carried out in Northeast India, according to the hospital.
